text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (—Run!! Run, run, with all your might!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(It all starts from here!
From here, I'm going to start running!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Toward the Triple Tiara
I've dreamed of forever and ever—!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: H-Haff... phuuu...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you so much--!!

...Slowly, she unclasped the fists
she had clenched so tightly without even realizing it.

Her hand—was burning hot.
Along with that heat, the memories come rushing back.
Her running. The sparkle she showed. Her potential.
Unable to bear it any longer, I dashed away from the scene.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trai—
choice_data_list: Craft, that was a great run!!
Craft, that was a great run!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa!?
U-Um, th-thank you very much!?

The moment I saw that she had returned,
I let out a shout. ...I might have gotten a bit
too excited, but it was from the bottom of my heart.

Come to think of it, it's been this way since before we signed our contract.
Rhein Kraft. Whenever I'm faced with her strength and her drive,
that's what comes to mind.
choice_data_list: As I thought, I can't help but dream when I'm with you.
As I thought, I can't help but dream when I'm with you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...!
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
...Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your support,
I managed to finish my debut race safely!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all the training you gave me,
I was able to achieve magnificent results!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Which means, starting from here—right!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Our dream.
Toward the Triple Tiara, it all starts here!"
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's sprint forward with everything we've got!
Yeah. Let's dash forward with everything we've got!

text_block_list.text:
It's great that we're all fired up,
but we're still just in the Junior Class.

First, I'd like to set a milestone to train toward
for next year's Triple Tiara challenge, but—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Today was 1,400m, but...
The first leg of the Triple Tiara,
the Oka Sho, is 1,600m, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Then we should definitely get used to racing at that distance...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And naturally, I want to compete
against lots of strong girls—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Our goal should be... a-a graded race, right?!
Like the Daily Hai Junior Stakes, or the Artemis Stakes...!!

There is nothing wrong with Rhein Kraft's thinking itself.
In terms of the overarching plan, I completely agree with her.

"However, the race she should be aiming for...
No, the race she truly deserves to aim for,
is another one entirely! That goal is—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A... A GⅠ race is our goal!?
Already!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: N-No, no, it's not like I hate it...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, the Hanshin JF certainly has many seniors
who went on to the Triple Tiara from there,
making it a GⅠ... S-So, well!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'd love to go!!
Wait, are you sure it's okay...!?"
choice_data_list: I'm saying this because I know you can do it.
I'm telling you this because I believe you can do it.

text_block_list.text:
"I tell her firmly, directly looking into her eyes.
—Praying that everything I feel gets through to her."

The thumping in my chest, the heat surging from the core of my body.
This heart that believes in her future holds everything.
choice_data_list: You're an Umamusume meant to take the Tiara, aren't you?
You're an Umamusume destined to claim the Tiara, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
...Yes, understood!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, let's take on the GⅠ!
I know I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: If it's with you, Trainer, we can do it! Absolutely!
